overview: An eight-pitch arete on the north side of the mountain, between a gully on the left and a split gully on the right. Cross the low-angle snowfield, then scramble about 100 ft to the base on the left of the face (cairn). The first two to two and a half pitches are loose; quality improves above. Trend right to a featured channel left of the prow, then up a short flaky corner. Higher pitches have 5.7 moves and featured rock to the slanting crest. Descend between the two small towers, downclimb about 10 ft, rappel from two hex stoppers, scramble Class 3 ledges to a second rappel with cordage, then take the loose second gully to talus and the meadow trail. Both rappels work with a 50m rope.
